commits.message:
fix(signature): recognize a relay's rigid From: block, exclude prohirespowerhouse.com

Two real production data-quality bugs reported by the user, both
confirmed against live needs_review drafts:

1. Many emails relayed via the PROHIRES POWERHOUSE broadcast platform
   prepend a rigid "From :\n<name>,\n<company>\n<email>\nReply to:
   <email>" block right after the subject/unsubscribe boilerplate,
   instead of a traditional "Regards," signoff. Without recognizing
   it, span detection fell through to the platform's own generic
   marketing footer at the very end, found nothing extractable there,
   and the real poster identity sitting right at the top -- clear,
   unambiguous, just not in a shape the generic name/company
   heuristics handle (a single first name with a trailing comma fails
   NAME_LINE_RE's 2-4-word requirement; a glued lowercase company like
   "alltechconsultinginc" has no COMPANY_SUFFIX_RE-recognizable
   suffix) -- went entirely unparsed. Adds RELAY_FROM_BLOCK_RE +
   _detect_relay_from_block, checked before the generic span
   detection, extracting name/company/email positionally rather than
   heuristically for this specific template.

2. prohirespowerhouse.com sends FROM its own shared domain
   (phph0xx@prohirespowerhouse.com) rather than just linking to it, so
   _sender_domain_website_fallback was deriving
   "https://prohirespowerhouse.com" as the recruiter's own website --
   confirmed on 2900+ drafts from this domain. Extends the existing
   JOB_BOARD_RELAY_URL_RE (previously nvoids.com only) to also exclude
   this domain, the same mechanism already used for the text-URL
   extraction path.

Adds 3 tests to scripts/hermes-850-email-signature-check.py: the
relay block extracts positionally, the detector never collides with a
real forwarded-email header (RAW_HEADER_BLOCK_RE's own shape), and
the domain exclusion for the website fallback.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
